summary: Native Maximum Peak Fit measurements now use the same 32-entry cache bound as the Compute route.
evidence: Bounded maximum analysis writes peakReductionCache directly at 1688 and the non-patch tiled path also writes directly at 2816. Only runPeakReduction caps that map at 32 (9923–9924). Maximum HDR is the default and does not need the compute path. Keys contain serialized lane and local recipes, so a long session with many settled edits retains old strings until session reset.
proposed_fix: Route native, tiled and compute anchor publication through the same bounded insertion helper without changing measurement keys.
check: Targeted highlight-anchor and peak tests exercise 40 distinct native Maximum edits, the newest 32 values and cache reset.
notes: fixes M3-13. The cache limit stays 32; no shader, anchor value or ceiling change.
